directness: Same-class attraction changes training and can change rankings, but does not directly constrain wrong competitor margins or protect weak-member competence
exact_failure_case: With view-invariant parallel same-class hidden vectors, all selected positive cosine derivatives vanish; different Qm can produce identical target-dependent gradients despite nontrivial target TV
nullspace_limit: Context-positive contrast can change head-unused representation directions without changing predictions; no actual-model stationary-point claim
common_control: Matches aggregate row-normalized target mass and denominator samples; generally changes per-route target support, concentration and entropy
permutation_control: Preserves restricted-positive degree, labels, panel membership and self positives; not public graph degree. Tests factual signature/node incidence rather than isolated topology
graph_specificity: Unestablished; X is one signature and controls do not uniquely isolate graph edges/hops
strongest_prediction: Beyond BOTH common and permuted targets, acquire enough positive competitor probability-margin mass for net full-population served repairs without mean/worst-member or NLL damage
prior_collision: Weighted multi-positive cross-view contrastive CE is established; no exact whole four-signature/top16/BE duplication certified or novelty inferred from bounded scope
fallback: None proposed; no diagnosed new error mechanism, and saved functional-response alternatives already have attributed priors/negative limits
development_limits: Same merged development role selected checkpoints and informed candidate
